### What do you want to be able to do? / 你想要做到什麼？

Describe the outcome, not the implementation.

描述你想達成的結果，而不是實作方式。

---

### Why / 為什麼

What are you doing today instead, and why is that not good enough?

你現在是怎麼做的？為什麼那樣不夠好？

---

### Anything else / 其他

Screenshots, links, or examples from other projects.

截圖、連結，或其他專案的做法。
